hero.title: High-energy dance fitness in Paris
hero.text: Join Zumba with B for an invigorating cardio workout powered by Latin rhythms, inclusive movement, and vibrant community energy. No dance experience needed; Just bring your sneakers and your smile.
hero.alt: Group dance fitness class in a bright brick studio

expect.title: What to expect in every session
expect.intro: Each class is crafted to provide a total-body cardiovascular workout that feels more like a dance party than gym work. Here is how we break down the evening from the moment you arrive.

steps.title: Warm-up and rhythm
steps.text: Doors open at 8:40 pm, with classes beginning promptly at 9:00 pm. We ease into the evening with a guided dynamic warm-up to prepare your joints and muscles for action.

steps.title: Cardio party
steps.text: Spend 60 minutes moving to vibrant salsa, bachata, merengue, and diverse global beats. Our easy-to-follow choreography lets you push your pace and unleash your style.

steps.title: Cool-down and socialize
steps.text: We wind down with calming stretches to enhance recovery, followed by 15 dedicated minutes after class to socialize, chat, and connect with fellow dancers.

expect.alt: Instructor mid-jump on a stage under bright lights

sections.title: Designed for all bodies and skill levels
sections.text: Never taken a dance class before? You are entirely welcome here. Our sessions welcome students of all ages, backgrounds, and fitness stages in a supportive, judgment-free space.

sections.title: What to bring and arrival times
sections.text: Arrive between 8:40 pm and 8:45 pm to get settled. Studio doors close firmly at 9:00 pm on the dot to ensure an uninterrupted experience for all participants. Wear supportive athletic shoes and flexible clothes you love moving in. Don't forget a large bottle of water to stay hydrated throughout the workout.
sections.alt: Workout clothes, water bottle, headphones and sneakers laid out on a table

sections.title: Booking and payment options
sections.text: Reserving your spot in advance online is the quickest way to guarantee your place on the dance floor. We also welcome direct messages to reserve, and cash payments are gladly accepted at the door prior to 9:00 pm.
